quote: Basic  earnings  per  share  decreased  by  22%  to  4.60  pence  (2018:  5.86  pence),  driven  by  the  decline  in  Group operating profit and the effect of higher net finance charges, predominantly due to IFRS 16. The adoption of IFRS 16 reduced the basic earnings per share calculation by 0.10 pence.
notes: This is the pre-exceptional basic EPS for the reporting period.
